mentions.name: Reorient
mentions.description: A digital nomad event and workation aggregator that also offers travel and visa guides to help remote workers get productive quickly in Japan and South Korea, with visa guidance for those wanting to stay longer.
mentions.problem: Remote workers lack aggregated event/workation information and travel/visa guidance for working productively in Japan and South Korea.
mentions.audience: Remote workers and digital nomads looking to be productive in Japan and South Korea and navigate visa options for longer stays.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Still working on my digital nomad event and workation aggregator.

But now with travel and visa guides to help remote workers become productive in Japan and South Korea ASAP and give them visa guidance if they want to stay a bit longer.

https://reorient.guide/
